## Purpose
Profile header card showing the avatar image, name, bio and an optional resume download button. It is a presentational component driven by props, with skeleton placeholders while loading.

## Key concepts
- `AvatarCardProps`: `profile` (`Profile | null`), `loading`, `avatarRing` (adds a primary-colour ring) and optional `resumeFileUrl`.
- Skeleton shown when `loading` or `profile` is null; uses `skeleton()` from [[src-utils]].
- Avatar rendered through [[src-components-lazy-image]] with `FALLBACK_IMAGE` from [[src-constants]] when `profile.avatar` is empty.
- Download Resume link renders only when `resumeFileUrl` is set; opens in a new tab with the `download` attribute.
